hunks.baseline: “If we get the chance, let’s meet again then. Just don’t wait too long.”
hunks.sol: “If we get the chance, let’s meet again. Just don’t be too late.”

hunks.baseline: The Eastern Heaven Demon Lord—or rather, Wei Zhong—fell silent.
hunks.sol: The Eastern Heaven Demon Lord—no, Wei Zhong—fell silent. Then he smiled faintly.

hunks.baseline: Then, at last, he gave a faint smile.
Without a word, he watched the dazzling flames that filled his vision.
hunks.sol: Without another word, he watched the dazzling flames fill his vision.

hunks.baseline: That warmth, strangely enough, wrapped around his entire body.
hunks.sol: Their warmth, strange as it was, wrapped around his entire body.
